extract_batch over URI inputs

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Xberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var result = await XbergConverter.ExtractBatchAsync(new List<ExtractInput>() { JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ExtractInput>("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf\"}", ConfigOptions)!, JsonSerializer.Deserialize<ExtractInput>("{\"kind\":\"uri\",\"uri\":\"https://example.com/text/fake_text.txt\"}", ConfigOptions)! }, new ExtractionConfig());
foreach (var resultItem in result.Results)
{
    Console.WriteLine(resultItem.Content);
}
```
